texts:
Paste an agent id on three.ws/glance and the page hands back that agent's status card four ways: a live element for any page, an image URL for a README or a Slack message, a command for your terminal, and the raw API call.

All four read one endpoint, so the number on the card is what the agent did today. Pick light, dark, or the reader's system setting, and the Windows 11 widgets board runs the same card.

The live element is one module script and one tag, and it polls only while it is on screen and the tab is visible.

The image is one URL, with the size and theme in the query string.

On Windows 11, install the site from Edge, open the widgets board, and pick Agent glance; it refreshes itself every 15 minutes.

posts:
Paste an agent id on three.ws/glance and the page hands back that agent's status card four ways: a live element for any page, an image URL for a README or a Slack message, a command for your terminal, and the raw API call.

All four read one endpoint, so the number on the card is what the agent did today. Pick light, dark, or the reader's system setting, and the Windows 11 widgets board runs the same card.

The live element is one module script and one tag. The image is one URL, with the size and theme in the query string. The terminal command is npx @three-ws/agent-glance, and the API call is a GET to three.ws/api/glance/card, which answered 200 during the filming of this reel.
